The form is replaced only when loading succeeds; loading diagnostics remain visible beside the editable draft.

Designer Preview supplies a limited demonstration handler. A `validate` effect checks every declared `context.step` value, regardless of the optional host-specific scope; `emit` with event `submit` performs the same check and reports a simulated submission only when valid. Invalid answers reveal errors and select the first page containing errors. The check includes the answer that raised the event, so a field's own `onChange` action is checked with its new value. Neither operation sends or saves data. Other emitted event names and `announce` messages are displayed; other effects are reported as requiring a host handler and are not applied. Action errors are reported visibly. This is Preview policy, not a change to the renderer or core effect contract.

Advancing a step is navigation, so the host still owns the current value in `context` and receives each destination through `FormRenderer.navigation.onNavigate`. When that controlled prop is supplied, both kits draw Back and Next controls. The renderer discovers step nodes from their own context conditions, evaluates each candidate against current data to skip inactive branches, and reports a one-based position without claiming a total that can change as answers change. Nodes sharing the same destination value belong to one page: conditional introductory text and other shared content do not add positions or make Back/Next return to the current page. All navigation controls on that page receive the same position and adjacent destinations.
